text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Kastam (Pulau 1) 2024.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Disember 2024.

Duti import tidak kena dibayar

2. Menteri mengisytiharkan bahawa tiada duti import kena dibayar bagi

barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang diimport masuk ke dalam Pulau 1 atau

yang diangkut ke Pulau 1 dari kawasan utama kastam.

JADUAL

(1) (2)

Bil. Barang-barang

1. Minuman keras yang memabukkan

2. Coklat

3. Minyak wangi

4. Kosmetik

Dibuat 20 November 2024

[SULIT KE.HD(122)860/02Klt.8(5); MOF.TAX(S)700-2/1/16 JLD.14; PN(PU2)338/JLD.75]

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH AZIZAN

Menteri Kewangan II

CUSTOMS ACT 1967

CUSTOMS DUTIES (PULAU 1) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 163Z(1)(a) of the Customs Act 1967

[Act 235] read together with section 163AA of the Act, the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Customs Duties (Pulau 1) Order 2024.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 December 2024.

Non-payable import duty

2. The Minister declares that no import duty shall be payable for the goods specified

in the Schedule which are imported into Pulau 1 or transported to Pulau 1 from

the principal customs area.

SCHEDULE

(1) (2)

No. Goods

1. Intoxicating liquors

2. Chocolates

3. Perfumes

4. Cosmetics

Made 20 November 2024

[SULIT KE.HD(122)860/02Klt.8(5); MOF.TAX(S)700-2/1/16 JLD.14; PN(PU2)338/JLD.75]

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH AZIZAN

Minister of Finance II
